quality.summary: Incident fix correctness: one Telegram card per job-permission request across revisions, idempotent redelivery, native inline keyboard, humanized HTML copy. Lite window Q-0073 (base 2dc2b1ce8 -> HEAD da42d4ffe): six autoreview rounds (codex gpt-5.6-sol high, incident brief plans/review-briefs/q-0073-incident.md); 7 findings accepted+fixed in-code with regression tests (telegram.test.ts: one-card-across-revisions, serialize/stale/malformed, retire-behind-in-flight-edit), 3 rejected as by-design (retire/replace zero-action path; restart idempotency owned by reconciler per-revision outcomes), 1 deferred as D-0058. verify.py Verification passed at HEAD; channels 40/980, application+jobs 138 files green.

non_blocking_findings.summary: FIXED: concurrent retries of one card revision could both send; mutations now serialized per chat-scoped card lane
FIXED: delayed older revision could edit the card back to stale text or send a second card; settlement keeps only the newest revision and suppresses stale ones
FIXED: malformed job_permission_decision affordances fell through to plain text; card path now enters on affordance kind and throws without a valid keyboard
FIXED: buttonless retire/replace edits and persisted-id recoveries now share the card lane (bound synchronously before the serialized section)

DEFERRED D-0058: zero-action retire/replace revisions carry no card identity into settlement, so a delayed older action revision could theoretically re-arm a retired card; needs payload/wiring contract change (durability owner boundary); upstream per-revision delivery outcomes cover the realistic path
